verdict.explanation: This market scores 8/100 — avoid it. This market expired 131d 14h ago and is still unresolved. Only 5isZ…XJgu can resolve it, and there is no on-chain deadline forcing resolution — winnings stay locked until that address acts, if it ever does. The pm-AMM program has no oracle, no dispute window, and no timelock — verified in the program source (none of its 34 instructions implements oracle, dispute, or timelock logic) and disclosed in its own docs. The resolution authority's decision is final. The only fallback in the system (permissionless voiding after a grace period) exists solely for bet-vault markets, and this market shows no evidence of being one. One key can upgrade the program: ETGK…7R6Y. The upgrade authority read from the ProgramData account is a single on-curve address — the shape of a plain keypair — with no on-chain evidence of multisig control. That key could replace the program logic, including resolution and vault rules, at any time. Last deployed at slot 511,269,300 (2026-10-15). 11 recent ProgramData transactions were observed (bounded RPC history — this may be incomplete and is not a full upgrade history; confirming an upgrade needs transaction parsing). The program has no third-party audit — its own docs describe it as a trust-based proof of concept. CRITICAL: this market is collateralized by 9GC7…7Hrr, not the devnet mUSDC mint (3WQ8…MEWZ). The program accepts any SPL mint as collateral, so the vault may hold a worthless or self-minted token even if the coverage ratio looks fine. Do not trade this market.
